name: gemm_reduce_8x6x8
stresses: the same ragged reduction with an arbitrary pad: rounding K up now sums garbage, and no opcode zeroes a scratchpad or vreg row
known_gap: the reduction pad must be zero for a T-granular mm to be exact, and the ISA has no way to produce a zero row: dma_ld is the only writer of spad and vr and it can only copy DRAM the host filled
